home.about_description: HomenaJesus is a digital songbook that brings songs, songbooks, chords, and repertoires together in one online place, so each service has its music ready and organized instead of scattered across loose sheets and folders.
features: Edit songs with aligned chords and a clear view for rehearsal or accompaniment.
Browse public songbooks organized by seasons, themes, or celebrations.
Prepare repertoires with event spaces, references, and more than one song in the same moment when needed.
Open live mode to follow the repertoire order with transposition, fullscreen, and font-size controls.
Keep material available to the team from desktop, tablet, or mobile.
home.platform_title: Do you also organize other repertoires?
home.platform_description: For other musical styles, you can use ChordProject.com, the general version of the platform.

songbook_page.option_use_official: Explore public songbooks organized by seasons, themes, or celebrations.
